description: This file defines the EmployeeTimeAtWorkDao class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically for handling attendance records related to employees in the dashboard plugin. It includes methods for retrieving the latest attendance record, attendance records within a date range, and open attendance records for a given employee.

classes.name: EmployeeTimeAtWorkDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for employee attendance records, providing methods to fetch latest, range-based, and open attendance records.

methods.name: getLatestAttendanceRecordByEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent attendance record for an employee based on their employee number.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecordsByEmployeeAndDate
methods.description: Fetches all attendance records for an employee within a specified date range, considering punch-in and punch-out times.

methods.name: getOpenAttendanceRecordByEmpNumber
methods.description: Finds the current open attendance record (if any) for a given employee who has punched in but not punched out.
